howItWorksTitle: How the BLADUS host balance works:
howItWorksBody: In line with Algerian banking practice, commission is deducted from your offline deposit rather than from automated guest payouts. To recharge your balance, make a transfer via BaridiMob or CCP and send the receipt to support.
